name: noc-portal-workspace
description: NOC Portal — Angular 21 frontend, TypeScript backend, reusable rules & workflow engines.

scripts.setup: node scripts/servers.mjs env && npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm run build:packages && npm run db:setup && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: node scripts/servers.mjs env && node scripts/servers.mjs check && npm run db:start && npm run db:migrate && npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api:only" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm -w @srisaa/noc-api run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm -w @srisaa/noc-api run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm run test:packages && npm -w @srisaa/noc-api run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.lint: eslint backend packages && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @srisaa/rules-engine run typecheck && npm -w @srisaa/workflow-engine run typecheck && npm -w @srisaa/noc-domain run typecheck && npm -w @srisaa/noc-api run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.build:packages: npm -w @srisaa/rules-engine run build && npm -w @srisaa/workflow-engine run build && npm -w @srisaa/noc-domain run build
scripts.test:packages: npm -w @srisaa/rules-engine run test && npm -w @srisaa/workflow-engine run test && npm -w @srisaa/noc-domain run test
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run smoke
